user.title: Smart Heatpump Controller
user.description: Select the entities for your heat pump controller.

data_description.thermostat_entity: The climate entity that controls your thermostat / heat pump.
data_description.p1_net_power_entity: Smart meter sensor in Watts. Positive = importing, negative = exporting solar.
data_description.weather_entity: Weather entity providing outdoor temperature and forecast. Met.no (weather.home) works out of the box.

error.entity_not_found: Entity not found. Check that it exists in Developer Tools → States.

abort.already_configured: Smart Heatpump Controller is already configured.

data_description.forecast_solar_entity: Forecast.Solar sensor for predictive solar boost. Leave empty if not installed.
data_description.notify_targets: Comma-separated notify service names without the 'notify.' prefix. Example: mobile_app_my_phone, telegram
data_description.active_months: Select the months when the controller should be active.
data_description.heatpump_power_entity: Optional. Electrical power of the heat pump (W or kW). Enables the solar energy sensors: kWh the heat pump used on solar surplus during a boost.
data_description.heatpump_heat_entity: Optional. Heat the heat pump delivers to the house (W or kW), e.g. Quatt's CIC Total power. Enables the heat-on-solar sensors: kWh of heat produced from solar during a boost. Needs the heat pump power sensor.

heatpump_grid_boost_today.name: Heat pump grid import while boosting today
